name: @papercusp/card-stack
description: Overlapping card-deck browser for same-type items — index-based transform animation (Motion card-stack pattern, pure CSS: mounted layers, fly-off/return, animated height), down-right stacked peeks with dimmed live content, on-card Prev/Next pills, keyboard arrows, story-style position dots, and an on-card category badge. Headless of domain: render-prop cards, theme via CSS custom properties with self-contained fallbacks. Zero runtime deps beyond React + lucide-react (peers).
